title: Reconnect-safe live DataSet discovery and hybrid RCB acquisition
titleId: Discovery DataSet live dan acquisition RCB hybrid yang aman saat reconnect
summary: ARSAS 1.6.31 completes the repaired live reporting pipeline from discovery through reconnect: DataSet members are retained, static and dynamic BRCB/URCB coverage is planned by ARIEC61850, only uncovered signals fall back to MMS polling, and a new MMS association cannot inherit report or command-correlation evidence from the previous connection.
summaryId: ARSAS 1.6.31 melengkapi perbaikan pipeline live reporting dari discovery sampai reconnect: member DataSet dipertahankan, coverage static dan dynamic BRCB/URCB direncanakan oleh ARIEC61850, hanya signal yang tidak ter-cover yang fallback ke MMS polling, dan association MMS baru tidak dapat mewarisi evidence report atau korelasi command dari koneksi sebelumnya.
highlights: Live discovery requests bounded DataSet directories and retains their members, preventing report-capable signals from disappearing between MMS discovery and the application catalog.
ARSAS executes the ARIEC61850 hybrid plan across static BRCB, static URCB, verified-free dynamic RCB slots, and per-signal MMS polling residuals.
Dynamic RCB planning supports temporary DataSets whose members reside in logical devices different from the RCB owner, as permitted by the live server model.
Report catalog matching selects the owning primary-value descriptor even when related quality and timestamp descriptors share the same primary reference.
Instantaneous magnitude values such as Hz.instMag.f resolve their quality and timestamp companions at Hz.q and Hz.t, while preserving clear operator-facing names.
Smart reconnect runs the same authoritative hybrid planner as initial monitoring, with fresh RCB availability checks and clean per-association report evidence.
highlightsId: Live discovery meminta directory DataSet secara terbatas dan mempertahankan member-nya, sehingga signal report-capable tidak lagi hilang di antara MMS discovery dan catalog aplikasi.
ARSAS mengeksekusi hybrid plan ARIEC61850 melalui static BRCB, static URCB, slot dynamic RCB yang terverifikasi free, dan residual MMS polling per signal.
Perencanaan dynamic RCB mendukung DataSet sementara dengan member pada logical device yang berbeda dari owner RCB, sesuai model live server.
Pemetaan report catalog memilih descriptor primary value pemiliknya walaupun descriptor quality dan timestamp terkait menggunakan primary reference yang sama.
Instantaneous magnitude seperti Hz.instMag.f menemukan companion quality dan timestamp pada Hz.q dan Hz.t, sambil mempertahankan nama yang jelas bagi operator.
Smart reconnect menjalankan authoritative hybrid planner yang sama dengan initial monitoring, termasuk pemeriksaan availability RCB terbaru dan evidence report per-association yang bersih.
improvements: Fresh RCB availability is revalidated before any setup write, and static or dynamic control blocks are reused only when the live evidence still permits it.
Physical validation evidence distinguishes successful RCB setup from actual report frames and verified process-value changes, avoiding false claims of report delivery.
Physical-validation mutation and snapshot capture are synchronized so operator diagnostics cannot observe torn counters or collection changes while report frames arrive.
The release source is gated by the standard ARSAS solution build and regression suite plus portable and Windows installer smoke validation before publication.
Stable Windows publication produces installer and portable binaries together with SHA-256 checksums, SPDX SBOM, application/engine provenance and GitHub artifact attestations.
improvementsId: Availability RCB terbaru divalidasi ulang sebelum setup write, dan control block static atau dynamic hanya digunakan ketika evidence live masih mengizinkannya.
Evidence validasi fisik membedakan setup RCB yang berhasil dari report frame aktual dan perubahan process value yang terverifikasi, sehingga tidak ada klaim palsu mengenai report delivery.
Mutasi dan snapshot physical validation disinkronisasi agar diagnostic operator tidak melihat counter yang torn atau perubahan collection ketika report frame masuk.
Source release digate oleh build solution dan regression suite ARSAS standard serta portable dan Windows installer smoke validation sebelum publikasi.
Publikasi Windows stable menghasilkan binary installer dan portable bersama SHA-256 checksum, SPDX SBOM, provenance aplikasi/engine dan GitHub artifact attestation.
knownLimitations: Physical relay validation remains necessary for device-specific engineering behavior that cannot be reproduced by CI, including vendor-specific model exposure and field network conditions.
A successful RCB setup is intentionally not treated as proof that report frames were received; field validation must confirm frames and value changes for the target IED and network.
The three-digit FAT timestamp display intentionally rounds the decoded timestamp to the nearest millisecond; full decoded precision remains available in evidence views.
Windows x64 is the only packaged desktop platform in this stable release.
The public binaries are not Authenticode code-signed; Windows SmartScreen may show an unrecognized-publisher warning.
Raw-Ethernet GOOSE and Sampled Values workflows require an administrator-installed and approved Npcap driver, suitable capture permission and visibility of the relevant multicast traffic.
knownLimitationsId: Validasi relay fisik tetap diperlukan untuk perilaku engineering spesifik perangkat yang tidak dapat direproduksi oleh CI, termasuk exposure model vendor-specific dan kondisi network di lapangan.
Setup RCB yang berhasil sengaja tidak dianggap sebagai bukti bahwa report frame telah diterima; validasi lapangan harus mengonfirmasi frame dan perubahan value pada IED dan network target.
Display timestamp FAT tiga digit secara sengaja membulatkan decoded timestamp ke millisecond terdekat; full decoded precision tetap tersedia pada evidence view.
Windows x64 adalah satu-satunya platform desktop yang dipaketkan pada stable release ini.
Binary publik belum ditandatangani dengan Authenticode; Windows SmartScreen dapat menampilkan peringatan unrecognized publisher.
Workflow raw-Ethernet GOOSE dan Sampled Values memerlukan driver Npcap yang telah dipasang dan disetujui administrator, capture permission yang sesuai dan visibility traffic multicast terkait.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable EXE do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible and are not hidden from users.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan portable EXE publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Karena itu peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul dan status ini tidak disembunyikan dari user.
